bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo DM_PG_NOT_UNIQUE;exit 71; }
echo DM_PG_RUNNING=YES
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -tA -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datallowconn AND NOT datistemplate ORDER BY datname"' | sed 's/^/DM_DATABASE=/'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -tA -c "SELECT to_regclass('\''public.videobot_creator_sessions'\''),to_regclass('\''public.videobot_sticker_packs'\'')" ' | sed 's/^/DM_EXISTING_SCHEMA=/'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'test -n "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" && echo DM_PG_ADMIN_SECRET=SET || echo DM_PG_ADMIN_SECRET=MISSING'
docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}DM_POSTGRES_NETWORK={{$k}}{{println}}{{end}}' "$pg"
echo DM_NODE_PG_PORT=5432
echo DM_HOST_NODE_AVAILABLE="$(command -v node >/dev/null && echo YES || echo NO)"
echo DM_HOST_NPM_AVAILABLE="$(command -v npm >/dev/null && echo YES || echo NO)"
echo DM_POSTGRES_PROBE_DONE
